objective: Standard statement: (1) erratum for ticket A, Theorem 4: its induction assumed that tight-cut contractions of a cubic triple system are again triple systems with distinct points per line, but a contraction can repeat a point in a line; its conclusion (every non-colourable cubic triple system is a Fano composition, hence 7 + 6k points) is false; (2) Fano blocks: Fano minus a line forces its three ports to one colour, so a cubic triple system with Fano blocks is 2-colourable iff its core (blocks contracted to points, lines possibly repeating a point) is; (3) a cycle of k Fano blocks, each joined to the next by a line through two ports of one block and one of the next, is a linear connected cubic triple system on 7k points that is not 2-colourable iff k is odd; with one twisted connecting line the parity flips, and the smallest twisted simple system (14 points, found by SAT, none on fewer) is the twisted 2-cycle; splicing two twisted 2-cycles gives an untwisted non-colourable system on 27 points; (4) hence the knot has three-fold spaces with 21, 27, 35, ... triangles that are not Fano compositions, the 21-triangle gadget exact at the knot; (5) refined conjecture: every non-colourable cubic triple system reduces, by contracting Fano blocks, to a core whose incidence multigraph is planar with all faces of length 2 mod 4 (odd cycles and their twisted and spliced forms). Nearest known result: tickets A and B; Robertson-Seymour-Thomas 1999 (Heawood and planar braces); Kasteleyn's face condition. Classification: to be decided.
status: Proved by THREEFOLD-SPACES-20261030-001C-P001 (V1): corrects ticket A's Theorem 4 (Fano compositions are not everything; contractions can repeat a point on a line); a Fano block forces its ports to one colour, so a cycle of k Fano blocks resists 2-colouring iff k is odd (7, 21, 35, ... points) and iff k is even with one twist; the twisted 2-cycle is the smallest twisted system (14 points, found by SAT) and two of them splice to a 27-point system; the knot has three-fold spaces with 21, 27, 35, ... triangles beyond Fano compositions; structure conjecture stated.
title: Odd cycles of Fano planes: beyond Fano compositions
